text:
maya: Quick sync — instrumentation onboarding for console telemetry PRD. Need to lock launch criteria and edge cases before next Wed. Main asks: onboarding checklist, sampling defaults, PII gating, and a minimal UX flow for first-run.
jonathan: Can you define what "onboarding" includes here? Is it just the in-console flow or also SDK/server-side config?
maya: Both. In-console flow to guide customers + a small SDK shim that emits a validated event schema. Goal: <30s to start streaming visible spans/logs after opt-in.
sam: Proposed acceptance criteria (first pass): 1) new customer can enable telemetry in console and see baseline metrics within 2 minutes, 2) default sampling = 1% with rules per route, configurable, 3) PII redaction enforced client-side + server-side gating, 4) docs + quickstart updated, 5) canary rollout to 5% of orgs. Thoughts?
lia: Edge cases: existing Dedicated/Private customers may be air-gapped — we need an offline onboarding path and a manual bundle they can upload. Also GDPR: opt-out must be enforced per org.
jonathan: For SDK shim — can we keep the schema tiny? sample event: ```json
{
  "event_type": "span",
  "service": "console",
  "route": "/models/generate",
  "latency_ms": 123,
  "trace_id": "<uuid>"
}
```
sam: That looks good. Also add a "redaction_flags" field so client can mark masked fields instead of sending raw PII.
maya: UX flow idea: modal on first login -> short checkbox + toggle for "share telemetry to improve product" -> link to policy page -> toggles for sampling level. Keep it opt-in for EU orgs.
lia: Launch criteria proposal: must-have: onboarding modal + telemetry toggle, SDK shim + validation, docs + migration guide for existing customers, automated tests for PII redaction. Nice-to-have: per-route sampling UI, histogram of incoming event sizes.
jonathan: Rollout plan: 1) internal-only for 2 weeks, 2) opt-in canary 5% orgs, 3) expand to 25% with feedback loop, 4) global GA. Instrumentation flags: feature flag + org preference.
sam: Danger/risks: accidental PII leak (need SRE/hard sandbox), increased token costs for telemetry storage, and misleading metrics if sampling config is inconsistent across SDK versions. We should add an acceptance test that simulates 0.1% sampling and validates downstream ratios.
maya: Decision items for product meeting: a) default sampling value (sam suggested 1%), b) whether to require server-side validation to drop non-whitelisted fields (lia suggested yes), c) exact canary cadence. Please vote in this thread before EOD tomorrow.
opsbot: deploy-bot: Note: telemetry-sdk v0.9.1 released to staging at 1959876600 — includes redaction_flags and schema validation.
jonathan: I'll vote for default 1% and server-side whitelist enforcement. Can we make sampling override only via console UI and API (no env var by default)?
lia: Vote: 1% default, server-side whitelist, and add offline bundle for private/DC customers.
sam: Vote: 1% default. Add acceptance test for sampling and a regression check for PII redaction.
maya: Thanks — I'm updating the PRD with these votes and will put the canary schedule in the rollout section. If anyone has objections to server-side whitelist enforcement please flag now. Otherwise I'll close this loop and file the follow-up tasks.
